sum: IZEA Worldwide, Inc. operates as a full-service creator economy agency. It provides creator economy solutions for marketers through managed services supported by its proprietary technology. The company manages custom content workflows, creator discovery and engagement, campaign execution, analytics, and payment processing. Its services include influencer marketing programs, customer-generated content, and custom content creation. It serves enterprise brands and agencies across a range of industries, as well as supporting small- and mid-sized businesses and independent creators. The company was formerly known as IZEA, Inc. and changed its name to IZEA Worldwide, Inc. in August 2018. IZEA Worldwide, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Orlando, Florida.
